On a small island in {wiki:Drefia} there is a chest with a pirate captain's savings. Cross Drefia, walk to the island and open the chest to receive a {item:Small Sapphire}, 50 gp and two books.
Loot a chest with the savings of a pirate captain.
It looks like the island is unreachable, but it is not: you can simply walk there and open the chest.

First go to **Darashia**: by boat (say {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes} to the captain in your city; you arrive at the harbour of {npc:Petros}) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). {wiki:Drefia} is **west** of Darashia, on the other side of the mountains that separate Ankrahmun, Darashia, Drefia and Tiquanda. There are several paths: for example, use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain at the marked rope spot, or come through the passage between Darashia and Ankrahmun. Follow the path to **Drefia**. Along the way you meet {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Tarnished Spirit|Tarnished Spirits}. You should arrive at this spot.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia

Head **west** to the chest. On the way you meet {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. The island has 2 {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons} and 1 {creature:Pirate Ghost}. Despite appearances, you can walk to the island.
The {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and the (invisible) {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} can catch low-level players by surprise.
Open the chest to receive the reward.

There is no shortcut out: go back the same way to Drefia and cross the mountain back to **Darashia** (by the rope spot or through the passage between Darashia and Ankrahmun). In Darashia take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Rope spot between Drefia and Darashia

Because of a bug in update 10.1, the chest of this quest was a {item:Treasure Chest (Ornamented)} that players could take. It was fixed at the server save of 18 July 2013 and that chest became sold in furniture shops for 1,000 gp.
